شَذْرٌ Pieces of gold that are picked up from the mine (S, A, K) without the melting, or smelting, (S, K,) of the ore: (S:) n. un. with ة: (S, K:) and pl. شُذُورٌ. (A.) And Beads made of gold to form divisions between pearls and jewels: (TA:) or beads by means of which other beads of a string are divided: (K:) or small pearls: (S, K:) or small things of gold, like the heads of ants, which are affixed to a [ring of the kind called] خَوْق: (Sh:) or, as some say, green beads: (Har p. 600:) n. un. with ة. (K.) ＝
-A2- شذر [app. شَذْرٌ] signifies [also, like تَشَذُّرٌ,] Briskness, liveliness, or sprightliness: and quickness in an affair. (Ham. p. 54.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
